name: kettlebell turkish get up to hand
description: The first part of a Turkish get up, rising from the floor to a seated position on your hand while holding a kettlebell overhead.
instructions: Lie on your back with a kettlebell pressed up in one hand and the same-side knee bent.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell.
Roll up onto your opposite elbow, then onto your hand.
Hold the seated position with your arm vertical.
Reverse the steps to lie back down, then switch sides.
